title: Pure Goblin
summary: Pure Goblin Biker Rank 3 and Rank 6 Xyz swarming build, featuring the rogue motorcycle gang and material-detaching mechanics with Rank-Up staples. The deck detaches Xyz materials from either player's field to flood the board, repeatedly triggering Goblin Biker Big Gabonga's monster absorption before climbing into Full Armored Dark Knight Lancer.

summary.title: Starters
points: Goblin Biker Grand Entrance searches any Goblin monster from your Deck, then optionally detaches 1 Xyz Material from either player's field to Special Summon a Level 4 or lower Goblin from your hand.
Tour Guide From the Underworld Normal Summons Goblin Biker Mean Merciless or Dugg Charger directly from your Deck for a 1-card Rank 3 Xyz Summon.
Speedroid Terrortop Special Summons itself without using a Normal Summon and adds Speedroid Taketomborg to overlay into Big Gabonga without using your Normal Summon.
Goblin Biker Dugg Charger detaches 1 material from anywhere on the field to Special Summon itself from hand, and searches any Goblin Spell or Trap on summon.

summary.title: Opening: Tour Guide
steps: Normal Summon Tour Guide From the Underworld to Special Summon Goblin Biker Mean Merciless from your Deck.
Overlay both monsters to Xyz Summon Goblin Biker Big Gabonga.
Big Gabonga triggers on summon to search Goblin Biker Dugg Charger from your Deck.
Special Summon Dugg Charger from your hand by detaching 1 material from Big Gabonga.
Big Gabonga triggers because an Xyz Material was detached, attaching an opponent's face-up monster (or a Goblin from hand or Deck) as material.
Dugg Charger searches Goblin Biker Grand Entrance to continue swarming into Xyz Armor Fortress and Full Armored Dark Knight Lancer.

summary.title: Material Detachment & Snatching
points: Goblin Biker Big Gabonga is the core engine piece: whenever an Xyz Material is detached from ANY monster on the field, it attaches 1 face-up monster on the field to itself as material.
Goblin Biker Boom Mach detaches 1 material from the field as a Quick Effect during either player's Main Phase to Special Summon itself from hand or GY, triggering Big Gabonga on the opponent's turn.
Goblin Biker Clatter Sploder revives a Goblin from GY on summon, and detaches 1 material on the opponent's Main Phase to revive itself.
Goblin Biker Mean Merciless summons a Goblin from hand on summon and detaches a material during your Main Phase to revive itself from the GY.

summary.title: Bosses & Armor Climb
points: Xyz Armor Fortress ranks up over any Rank 3 Xyz, searches Full-Armored Xyz, and detaches its own materials to enable an immediate rank-up into Full Armored Dark Knight Lancer.
Full Armored Dark Knight Lancer attaches an opponent's monster to itself whenever an Equip Card is equipped, and provides extra materials for the Bikers.
Goblin Biker Troika Griare lets Goblins attack directly while you control 3+ materials, changes battle positions, and negates attacks.
Goblin's Crazy Beast detaches 2 materials as a Quick Effect to attach an opponent's Spell/Trap to itself as material.
Number F0: Utopic Draco Future provides unbreakable destruction immunity, monster effect negation, and monster theft.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Goblin Biker Grand Stampede is a Continuous Trap that detaches an Xyz Material on the field to negate an Effect Monster's effects for the turn.
Goblin Freefall Squad attaches an opponent's monster summoned from the Extra Deck directly to a Goblin Xyz Monster as material.
Goblin Biker Grand Breakout tributes a monster to summon a Goblin Biker from Deck with targeting immunity, and Grand Bash boosts ATK and modulates Levels.

main: Goblin Biker Dugg Charger
Level 3 EARTH Warrior that detaches 1 Xyz Material from EITHER field to Special Summon itself from hand, and searches any 'Goblin' Spell/Trap on Normal or Special Summon.
Goblin Biker Mean Merciless
Level 3 WATER Fiend that Special Summons a Goblin from hand on Normal/Special Summon, and detaches 1 Xyz Material from either field during your Main Phase to revive itself from the GY.
Goblin Biker Clatter Sploder

Level 3 FIRE Psychic that revives a Goblin from your GY on Normal/Special Summon, and detaches 1 Xyz Material from either field as a Quick Effect during the opponent's Main Phase to revive itself from the GY!
Goblin Biker Boom Mach

Level 3 WIND Warrior that detaches 1 Xyz Material from either field as a Quick Effect during either Main Phase to Special Summon itself from hand or GY (instantly triggering Big Gabonga's monster-attach on the opponent's turn!).
Goblin Bikers Gone Wild
Level 6 DARK Beast-Warrior that Special Summons itself from hand/GY if you control no monsters or only Goblins, and summons a Level 4 or lower Goblin from Deck on Normal/Special Summon.
Tour Guide From the Underworld
One-card Rank 3 Goblin Biker Big Gabonga starter that summons Dugg Charger or Mean Merciless from the Deck.
Speedroid Terrortop
Summons itself without using the Normal Summon and searches Taketomborg for an instant Rank 3 Big Gabonga.
Speedroid Taketomborg
Summons itself from hand alongside Terrortop.
Goblin Biker Grand Entrance

Searches any 'Goblin' monster from your Deck, then lets you detach 1 Xyz Material from either field to Special Summon a Level 4 or lower Goblin from your hand; banishes from GY to detach 1 material and add a Goblin from GY to hand.
Goblin Biker Grand Breakout
Quick-Play Spell that tributes 1 monster you control to Special Summon a Goblin Biker from your Deck with a different Type, and neither player can target it with monster effects this turn.
Goblin Biker Grand Bash
Continuous Spell that boosts all Goblin monsters by 300 ATK, grants an extra Normal Summon of a Goblin monster, and modulates two Goblins' Levels for Rank 3 or Rank 6 Xyz plays.
Goblin Biker Grand Stampede
Continuous Trap that detaches 1 Xyz Material on the field while you control a Goblin Biker to negate an Effect Monster on the field.
Goblin Freefall Squad
Trap that attaches an opponent's monster summoned from the Extra Deck directly to a Goblin Xyz Monster you control as material.
Full-Armored Xyz
Searched by Xyz Armor Fortress to Xyz Summon Full Armored Dark Knight Lancer on the opponent's turn.
extra: Signature Rank 3 Xyz boss: searches any 'Goblin' monster on Xyz Summon, attaches 1 face-up monster on the field as material whenever an Xyz Material is detached from ANY monster on the field (triggered on the opponent's turn by Boom Mach or Clatter Sploder!), and attaches a Goblin from Deck in the End Phase.

Rank 6 Xyz boss (summoned using two Level 6 Gone Wild or via Grand Bash) that lets your Goblins attack directly while you have 3+ Xyz Materials on field, changes an opposing monster's battle position on summon, and detaches 1 material when an opponent attacks to negate the attack.
Rank 6 Fiend Xyz that detaches 2 materials as a Quick Effect to attach 1 Spell/Trap on the field to itself as material, and detaches 1 material to protect your Xyz Monsters from destruction.
Rank 5 Xyz that ranks up over a Rank 3, searches Full-Armored Xyz, and has its materials detached by Dugg Charger/Mean Merciless so Full Armored Dark Knight Lancer can immediately rank up over it!
Rank 7 Xyz boss that equips an opponent's monster when an equip occurs and provides extra Xyz Materials for Goblin Bikers.
Rank 0 Xyz: stacks on Utopic Future, cannot be destroyed by battle or effects, and negates and steals monster effects.
